title: Macbeth
author: William Shakespeare
summary: After three witches predict he will be king, the Scottish general Macbeth murders the reigning king with the urging of his wife. His crimes and growing paranoia lead him into more killing and toward ruin.
readIf: you want a short, intense tragedy about ambition and guilt.
skipIf: you find Shakespearean verse hard going or dislike bleak plays.
